ranger_v0.0.1-rando.description:
# Pokemon Ranger Shadows of Almia randomizer

This is a randomizer that randomizes the Pokémon all over almia! It makes use of the Archipelago framework but currently does not yet have Archipelago support. This is to come.

See [the docs](https://github.com/WCutePy/ArchipelagoAlmia/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_ranger_soa/docs/en_PokemonRangerSoA.md) for more information

## What does randomization do to this game?

Pokemon randomization can change the following.
- Wild encounters
  - Excluding Doduo and Staraptor
- Static encounters
  - Excluding boss encounters
- NPC Pokémon (WIP)
- Partners

Multiple algorithms are (not yet) possible for wild encounter randomization.
As a base this randomizer ensures the 
story is always beatable, by iterating over wild encounters
as they become accessible in the story and placing required field moves amongst all currently accessible spots.

Movement field moves such as swim, river flow or airlift have multiple copies placed such that moving back and forth over their terrain is always possible.

Quest required pokemon are placed across all potential spots.
Static encounters are filled such that they have a similar HP to their original counter part. Remaining wild spots are filled randomly, ensuring one of each species exists in the wild.

**NOTE** This rando spans the full story, the randomizer does **not** randomize postgame or ensure postgame quests are beatable.

Actual apworld file and linked commit are not in sync, but did not want to make a 0.0.2 already even though I could be sitting at 0.0.4 with these patches 😢 

--- update ---
There is a bug during the perill cliffs mission. You can end the day at any point in time, by just going to vientown. This will brick your save file. Make sure to complete the mission, talk to the jam maker and see the doduo tutorial.
Will be fixed on next release

ranger_v0.1.0.description:
Now with Archipelago support! The default YAML is for a normal randomizer, with all Archipelago features turned off.

## Adds
- Mission locations
- Species capture locations
- Quest locations
- Field move item
- Deathlink
- Capture Card items
- Partner items
- Styler model items
- Level items
- Rank items
- Allows several combined goals
- - Missions
- - Quests
- - Captures

## Bugfixes
- Softlocking in mission 7 by ending mission 6 early is no longer possible
- Allow generating with multiple copies of shadows of almia
- Limited the unique mons on known maps with issues

## Known bugs
- Partner shows up during the kricketot scene (and is available to swap with while having said partner)
- Some maps have glitchy sprites (from too many unique mons, please report these on the discord)
